purpose: Public-safe proof that Mac Henry systematically discovers, filters, tests and scales income opportunities while protecting capital and private strategy.
experiment_rules: Prefer the smallest ethical test that can materially reduce uncertainty.
Define success, stop and review thresholds before a material test begins.
Do not scale solely from vanity metrics; require evidence tied to revenue, margin, retention, cash flow or validated demand.
Stop or redesign weak experiments before they consume disproportionate cash or owner attention.
Successful tests must pass capacity, downside, dependency and owner-review gates before material scaling.
When a winner is identified, evaluate repeatability, automation, reusable assets, recurring revenue, pricing power and distribution leverage for compounding.
Failed tests should preserve useful evidence and reusable assets when lawful and practical.
Public Henry never receives private opportunity rankings, private financial context, customer private data, credentials, account access or Mac Henry private strategy.
Opportunity analysis is advisory and never grants spending, contracting, transfer, investment, trading or execution authority.
